blog-card-soft.label: Soft
blog-card-soft.desc: Large radius, medium shadow, roomy padding — friendly and modern.

blog-index-classic-list.label: Classic List
blog-index-classic-list.desc: Stacked full-width posts with an excerpt — the timeless blog. Meta below the title, numbered pages.

copyright-settings-simple.label: Simple
copyright-settings-simple.desc: A single centered copyright line (the year updates automatically).

copyright-settings-split-menu.label: Copyright + Menu
copyright-settings-split-menu.desc: Copyright on the left, a footer menu on the right.

copyright-settings-split-social.label: Copyright + Social
copyright-settings-split-social.desc: Copyright on the left, social icons on the right.

footer-centered.label: Simple Centered
footer-centered.desc: One centered column: logo, footer menu and social icons - minimal and tidy.

footer-contact.label: Contact Strip
footer-contact.desc: Address, phone and email across three columns - an at-a-glance contact band.

footer-cta.label: Call to Action
footer-cta.desc: A single centered headline and button - a strong closing prompt before the footer.

footer-four-col.label: Four Columns
footer-four-col.desc: Four equal link columns (Product / Company / Resources / Legal) - the standard SaaS footer.

footer-logo-links.label: Logo + Links
footer-logo-links.desc: A branding column (logo + blurb + social) beside three link columns.

footer-menu-social.label: Menu + Social
footer-menu-social.desc: Footer menu on the left, social icons on the right.

footer-newsletter.label: Newsletter CTA
footer-newsletter.desc: A headline + blurb on the left and a subscribe button on the right - the classic email opt-in band.

footer-social.label: Centered Social
footer-social.desc: A single centered row of social icons.

footer-three-col.label: About + Links + Contact
footer-three-col.desc: A wide About column, a Quick Links column, and a contact column - a friendly small-business footer.

header-bar-glass-sticky.label: Bar · Glass Sticky
header-bar-glass-sticky.desc: Full-width bar that turns frosted-glass and sticks on scroll.

header-bar-uppercase.label: Bar · Uppercase
header-bar-uppercase.desc: Static full-width bar with uppercase nav and a hairline border.

header-bottombar-centered-nav.label: Centered Menu
header-bottombar-centered-nav.desc: A single centered secondary menu — clean and symmetric.

header-bottombar-nav.label: Secondary Menu
header-bottombar-nav.desc: A secondary / category menu on the left — great for sub-navigation under the main header.

header-bottombar-nav-search.label: Menu + Search
header-bottombar-nav-search.desc: Secondary menu on the left, a search field on the right — the storefront sub-bar.

header-bottombar-nav-social.label: Menu + Social
header-bottombar-nav-social.desc: Secondary menu on the left, social icons on the right.

header-centered-sticky.label: Centered · Sticky
header-centered-sticky.desc: Centered logo over centered nav, sticky with a soft shadow.

header-centered-uppercase.label: Centered · Uppercase
header-centered-uppercase.desc: Centered logo over uppercase centered nav, static with a hairline border.

header-elevated-card.label: Elevated Card
header-elevated-card.desc: Header floats as a raised card, sticky.

header-floating-pill-caps.label: Floating Pill · Uppercase
header-floating-pill-caps.desc: Rounded floating nav bar, sticky, with uppercase menu labels.

header-fullscreen-overlay.label: Fullscreen Overlay
header-fullscreen-overlay.desc: Hamburger opens a fullscreen Concentric menu.

header-main-centered-logo.label: Centered Logo
header-main-centered-logo.desc: Menu on the left, logo centered, a CTA on the right — a balanced, boutique split.

header-main-commerce.label: Logo + Search
header-main-commerce.desc: Logo left, a search field centered, menu right — the storefront header.

header-main-logo-menu.label: Logo + Menu
header-main-logo-menu.desc: Logo on the left, primary menu on the right — the classic arrangement.

header-main-menu-cta.label: Menu + CTA
header-main-menu-cta.desc: Logo left; the menu and a call-to-action button on the right — the SaaS / marketing header.

header-menu-classic.label: Classic
header-menu-classic.desc: Theme defaults — a clean bar with a soft-shadowed dropdown. Also resets the Menu tab.

header-pill-glass.label: Floating Pill · Glass
header-pill-glass.desc: Rounded floating nav, sticky, frosted-glass with a soft shadow.

header-topbar-announcement.label: Announcement
header-topbar-announcement.desc: A single centered promo line — great for shipping offers or campaigns.

header-topbar-contact-hours.label: Contact + Hours
header-topbar-contact-hours.desc: Phone + email on the left, opening hours centered, social icons on the right.

header-topbar-contact-social.label: Contact & Social
header-topbar-contact-social.desc: Phone + email on the left, social icons on the right — the classic business top bar. Edit each element after applying; social icons use Theme Settings → Social.

header-topbar-info-social.label: Info & Social
header-topbar-info-social.desc: Address + phone on the left, social icons on the right.

header-vertical-rail.label: Vertical Rail
header-vertical-rail.desc: Fixed side rail with the logo + menu.

page-article-right.label: Article (Right Sidebar)
page-article-right.desc: Content with a right sidebar; breadcrumbs and featured image on.

page-docs-left.label: Docs (Left Sidebar)
page-docs-left.desc: Left sidebar for navigation, breadcrumbs on, no featured image.

page-focus-reading.label: Focus Reading
page-focus-reading.desc: Hide breadcrumbs and the featured image for a clean reading page.

page-full-context.label: Full Context
page-full-context.desc: Show breadcrumbs and the featured image above the content.

page-minimal.label: Minimal
page-minimal.desc: No sidebar, no breadcrumbs, no featured image — bare content.

portfolio-archive-case-study.label: Case Study (Designer)
portfolio-archive-case-study.desc: Two roomy columns with category + summary on the cards — a curated, story-led work index.

social-style-minimal.label: Minimal
social-style-minimal.desc: Bare glyphs, a touch larger, that shift to the primary color on hover.
